description: Word counts measured with Microsoft Word for Mac 16.113.2 (AppleScript compute text range statistics), 2026-09-26. Each text was inserted into a blank document and measured as a range excluding the final paragraph mark. Rows with hangulPerSyllable were measured on text not tagged as Korean.
